content:
maria: small follow-up from today's all-hands on pricing/credits — putting notes here so people can ask clarifying Qs.

jon: are credits refunded if we downgrade mid-cycle? e.g., move from Pro -> Free.

phil: downgrade: we don't issue cash refunds; unused paid-tier credits are converted to a limited grace balance that can be used for a short period (30 days) to avoid immediate disruption. exact UX will appear in the billing page soon.

maria: what about simultaneous quota enforcement + dedicated capacity? a customer said they were rate-limited despite having reserved GPUs.

ops-bot: FYI: Reserved pools enforce per-pool throughput. Global throttles are only applied for platform stability or abuse detection and are rare. If you see both, please collect request IDs and we can triage.

sophie: are embedding calls billed per vector or per input token? customers get confused when they chunk texts.

phil: embedding billing is per-vector returned; additional token charges apply only if model tokenization is used for preprocessing (e.g., if a customer uses the text-generation endpoint to chunk then embed). We'll add examples to the docs.

jon: retries question: do failed retries consume credits? customer automated retries ate their monthly budget.

ops-bot: System: failed or rate-limited requests (4xx/5xx) do not consume credits. Only successful responses count. Retries that eventually succeed will be billed for the final successful call.

maria: actionable items: 1) billing page detail on proration and downgrade behavior, 2) embed/token FAQ with worked examples, 3) client lib retry guidance (backoff + jitter) and tie to non-billable failures.

sophie: thx — can we get a short blurb for the help center and a pin in billing channel?

phil: yes, i'll draft the blurb and post in #billing by EOD.

maria: great, i'll consolidate these into a small FAQ and link to it from the all-hands notes. thanks everyone.
